# HEM v0.8.6b3 – Continuous target lines in room trends

Room trends show the configured HEM target as a solid step line. If a sensor stops reporting or returns, the target stays level until HEM changes it. A profile change during that interval steps at its recorded time.

The chart also uses compatible target records already in history. Earlier records can retain small gaps where continuity was never recorded. Home Assistant restarts and unavailable targets still interrupt the line. Measurements, PID demand and device output keep their recorded intervals.
